# Nick Tan

> Software engineer and entrepreneur. I build businesses and solve problems with code.

Personal portfolio site for Nick Tan, available at nick-tan.com.

## About

Nick Tan is a software engineer and entrepreneur based in Singapore. He spent over eight years building enterprise data discovery software in C++ and now works with AI. He is open to roles, consulting and collaborations.

He leads three businesses:
- **That Pet Supply Store** (thatpetsupplystore.com) — online pet supply store in Singapore, founded 2026, run on a back office he built (orders, shipping labels, supplier stock sync, Telegram ops bot)
- **Spot-On Inspectorate** (soi.com.sg) — building inspection and consultancy in Singapore, founded 2024; prototyping AI that turns site notes and photos into defect reports
- **The Shuffle Spot** (shopee.sg/robobooga) — premium playing cards and hobby supplies

## Expertise

- **Systems** — over eight years on enterprise data discovery software in C++: cross-platform file scanning (Windows, Linux, macOS) and connectors for databases, cloud storage and servers
- **AI** — building with LLMs: document question answering with citations, agents, MCP servers, and red teaming prompts against injection
- **Operations** — running an online store end to end: suppliers, listings, ads and fulfilment, on a self-built back office
- **Product** — turning requirements into specifications and proof-of-concepts with Product and UI/UX teams; tier-3 engineering contact for complex customer issues

## Current Projects

- **Ourobor-OS** (nick-tan.com/ourobor-os) — Observability and documentation for your codebase. Keeps a living, LLM-maintained wiki that explains what the code does and why, flags comments, TODOs and docs that have drifted out of sync, and is growing into a sidecar companion that observes the codebase.

## Chrome Extensions

- **OOTD Transcript Downloader** (nick-tan.com/ootd-transcript-downloader) — Browser extension that downloads YouTube transcripts in one click, ready to feed into an AI.
- **Data Bouncer** (nick-tan.com/data-bouncer) — Browser extension that converts and sanitizes webpages and articles into markdown for LLMs to process.

## Interests

Artificial Intelligence, Cybersecurity, Network optimization, E-commerce scaling, Entrepreneurship, Retail logistics, Cue Sports, Gaming, Personal Finance, Sleight of Hand & Playing Cards.
